decisions.reason: Selecting the Seattle page as the future-location template does not change the dedicated-page model, current location list, or cross-location consistency requirement.
The template-basis decision concerns reusable page design and does not establish a change to the standalone Wix-account architecture for locations.
Using Seattle as a future page template does not add a location option or change selector behavior or routing destinations.
The future-location template basis does not change the national master site's role, positioning, or booking responsibilities.
The candidate already records the Seattle booking transition stated in the message; designating Seattle as a future template adds no necessary booking-system change.
The future page-template decision does not alter the candidate's current location data-isolation rules.
Using Seattle as a reusable page template does not change the established brand name, colors, positioning, or cross-location branding consistency.
Template designation does not change Seattle's own coming-soon mode, page sections, button label, or opening transition; the reusable relationship is already owned by the source Requirement.
The Seattle template basis does not replace or contradict the existing competitor references, visual style, or design-consistency constraints.
A reusable page-template basis has no necessary effect on separate payment setups or location payout handling.
The source does not necessarily extend Seattle's VIP signup requirement to every future location, and it does not change the Seattle signup type or label.
The Seattle page is a future-location template, not a replacement for or modification of the master homepage section composition.
